    Major Events in 2026 
    • FIFA World Cup 2026: Hosted by the USA, Canada, and Mexico (June-July), featuring 48 teams in 104 matches, according to FIFA and Wikipedia.
    • U.S. 250th Anniversary: July 4th marks the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence, say Wikipedia and Facebook.
    • Space Exploration
      :

    • Sports: The Winter Olympics and Paralympics are set for Italy, notes Facebook.
    • Elections: U.S. midterm elections are scheduled for November, according to Wikipedia and YouTube. 
    Economic and Social Predictions
